title: Normalized shifts and pretriangulated data at common coefficient stages
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $\Omega$ be an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme of finite dimension on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the completed integral coefficient categories and their raw rationalizations $\mathcal C_E(T)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], indexed by finite coefficient fields $E\subset\Omega$, with the scalar system and pair category $\mathcal P_T$ of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category]. Define the following normalized structures on these existing categories, without changing their objects or morphisms.

The integer shift on $\mathcal C_E(T)$ is induced by signed reindexing on integral complexes, extended linearly on tensor Hom modules. Its shift-zero and shift-add comparisons are the localized integral comparisons. Equip integral rationalization with the shift comparison whose components are identities. Equip each scalar transition $T_{F/E}$ with the shift comparison $\sigma_{F/E}$ obtained from the adjunction mate of the derived scalar-restriction comparison, restricted through the integral full inclusion and descended through rationalization.

Define $(E,K)[n]=(E,K[n])$ and, writing categorical composition from right to left,
$$[M,u][n]=[M,\sigma_{M/F,L}^{-1}\circ u[n]\circ\sigma_{M/E,K}].$$
Use the images of the finite-stage shift-zero and shift-add maps for the pair shift coherence. Equip each inclusion $j_E$ with the comparison having identity components on included objects. Give $\mathcal P_T$ a zero object represented by any finite-stage zero object. Finally, give $\mathcal P_T$ the pretriangulated structure [def-weil-triangulated-category] whose distinguished triangles are exactly the common-stage cone triangles of [def-weil-pbc-common-stage-cones], retaining the specified shift and the existing additive Hom groups. These are the existing normalized data structures; this definition makes no new assertion of the common-stage calculus or the Verdier axioms.

lean.note: Definition attachment requested by H2 of the independent return. The first six constructors are implemented in Sheaf.Paper.CommonStageCalculus and publicly reexported by PbcVerdierAxioms through PbcCommonStageCones; the final constructor is defined in PbcVerdierAxioms itself. This record owns the actual normalized data used in the item, including qbarPairPretriangulated, without replacing any theorem record or duplicating any declaration. The generic StageSystem constructors specialize literally to pbcScalarSystem. The rational and comparison choices come from locally proved uniquely normalized helpers; the pair shift and zero object have explicit data, and the pretriangulation retains the fixed common-stage distinguished predicate.
